dataList.content:
Tell me everything. Please, give me a true history of the event. How did... How did C-Cathy die? Did she pass away with the same kind smile on her face?
她到底是怎么死的，请告诉我一切。到底……为什么凯……凯茜会……死？她也是带着和平常一样的温柔笑容闭上双眼的吗？

Quietly, as a lamb.
她走时像羔羊一样地安静。

dataList.content:
And—did she ever mention me?
她……她就没有提起过我吗？

She could not; for her senses never returned. She lay with a sweet smile on her face. Her life closed in a gentle dream... may her final slumber be a peaceful one.
她没有办法，她的知觉根本没有恢复过。她脸上带着甜蜜的微笑躺着，她的生命是在一个温柔的梦境里得到终止的，愿她在另一个世界里也平和地安眠。

Wha... what?

Haunt me then, Cathy! Be a ghost and haunt me, be with me always! Only do not leave me in this abyss, where I cannot find you. I cannot live without you!
缠着我吧，凯茜！变成鬼魂缠着我吧，永远跟着我吧！只要别把我撇在这个深渊里，这儿我找不到你！没有你，我不能活下去啊！

H-Heathcliff?
希……希斯克利夫？

dataList.content:
But that was a wrong question to ask. ... You should've asked me why I endured, not why I left.
但比起问我为什么要离开……倒不如问我为什么能忍耐下去。

The thrashings, the humiliation, the scorn, the pain, the starvings... I could endure it all. I just had to weather it, let it pass over me. That's what I always did, anyway.
对我的鞭打、嘲弄、蔑视……所有的痛苦以及饥饿，我都可以忍受。忍受下去就好了。这就是我一直以来所做的。

Despite all that, I decided to leave Wuthering Heights behind because...
虽然我从这一切中坚持到现在，但还是决定要离开呼啸山庄的理由是……

... because I finally realized something.
因为我终于明白了。

... So Linton will be made quite affluent soon. If I were to marry him... I shall be the greatest inventor of the neighborhood, no? Perhaps I shall be awarded the 'Inventor of the Year' award from T Corp!
……所以林顿很快就会变得相当富有，如果我嫁给他的话……我就能成为这附近最伟大的发明家对吧？说不定我还能获得今年的T公司发明家奖！

dataList.content:
Then... what of Heathcliff, Miss Catherine?
那么……希斯克利夫该怎么办呢，小姐？

Nelly, please! Don't say such foolish things. It would degrade me if I were to marry Heathcliff.
耐莉，你在说些什么？嫁给希斯克利夫会降低我身份的。

We'd both be destitute if such a thing were to happen.
那样我们俩都免不了变成乞丐的。

<color=#dc3531>Tell me. Tell me why you couldn't bear to remain at Wuthering Heights anymore.</color>
<color=#dc3531>能告诉我吗？告诉我你为什么无法忍受在呼啸山庄继续待下去。</color>

Because I finally understood that Catherine...
因为我终于明白，凯瑟琳她……

... did not love me.
不爱我了。

And if I had to stay here and watch her marry Linton, right before my eyes...
如果我继续留在这里，看着她在我面前嫁给林顿的话……

... I would have done something so violent, so brutal against Linton... or even against Cathy.
我肯定会对林顿……甚至会对凯茜……做出暴行的。

I could not stand that. Not even the idea of it.
我根本无法忍受，甚至想都不敢想。

So I ran.
因此我逃走了。

From this manor that degraded me, made me a wretch.
从这座让我变得卑贱的宅邸中，逃走了。

From this manor that taught me love, only to deprive me of it.
从这幢教会我爱，又将它从我手中夺去的宅邸中，逃走了。

... No. I was always a wretch. From the moment I was born.
……不，我打出生起就是个卑贱的乞丐。

A lowly thing like me should not have been allowed to be here in the first place. That's why I tore myself from it.
卑贱如我是不被允许生活在此等宅邸之中的。这就是我为什么会把自己从那儿撕裂出去。

But... I've never given up on Cathy.
但我……永远不会放弃凯茜。

I only wanted her to realize that she was wrong. To regret what she's done. So that she'll one day return to me.
我只是希望有一天能让凯茜改变她的想法，为自己做过的事感到后悔，想让她有朝一日能够回到我的身边。

<color=#dc3531>But... what about now?</color>
<color=#dc3531>可是……现在呢？</color>

Pointless. It's all pointless.
毫无意义。一切都毫无意义了。

<color=#dc3531>Then... what can you do now?</color>
<color=#dc3531>那么……你现在还能做些什么呢？</color>

dataList.content:
I said I'm back, Cathy...
我已经回来了，凯茜……

<color=#dc3531>Look at him. What do you feel?</color>
<color=#dc3531>看着他的那副样子，你感觉如何？</color>

... Is that even a human?
这还是人类的所作所为吗？

Isn't that thing just a bundle of waste, wrapped in a filthy rag that only resembles human flesh?
只是披着人皮，内里装满垃圾的破布袋而已。

I've changed? That I'll show her how I've grown as a person?
我改变了？我会让她看到我改变后的样子？

No. Of course not. It never could have worked from the start.
不，根本不可能。这一切从开始就不成立。

How could it, when I'm not even a person?
我连人类都算不上。

<color=#dc3531>What do you think of yourself, Heathcliff?</color>
<color=#dc3531>希斯克利夫。你是如何看待你自己的？</color>

Do I even deserve to speak as humans do?
我有必要像人类一样说话吗？

I, who killed Catherine...
害死凯瑟琳的我……

You, who deprived me of Catherine...
把凯瑟琳从我身边夺走的你……

... Must be a thing lesser than a savage beast.
一定是比野兽还要劣等的存在。

Then...
那么……

... why should I even keep pretending to be human when I am not?
我还有必要特地装作人的样子吗？

If they were right... that if I really were to become nothing more than a howling, savage beast...
如果真的像那个混账所说……我变成了无法沟通的野兽……

<color=#dc3531>A wild, heartbroken hound, abandoned by his master...</color>
<color=#dc3531>被主人遗弃的，哭嚎着胡闹的悲伤猎犬……</color>

<color=#dc3531>... that is the shape of your heart and its desire, isn't it?</color>
<color=#dc3531>那正是你此刻的愿望，是你所想成为的样子啊。</color>

Yes. I shall become an infernal hound; snarling, tearing at the fabric of the City... And I will shove its remnants into this sack... and grate it across the broken earth.
没错。我将成为地狱的猎犬，向着都市狂吠。把他们全部撕成碎块，装进麻袋中四处拖行。

I curse myself... and everything that did this to me and Cathy...
我诅咒……诅咒让我和凯茜……变成这样的一切……

<color=#dc3531>Then it can be as you wish.</color>
<color=#dc3531>你的愿望会实现的。</color>

Run, Heathcliff!
快跑，希斯克利夫！

Run!
快跑！

Cathy, your ankle...!
凯茜，你的脚踝……！

Go! I said go!
跑！我说了叫你快跑！

I... I promise I'll...!
我……我绝对……！

I promise I'll come back for you.
我绝对会回来的。

<color=#4e3076>Welcome home, Heathcliff.</color>
<color=#4e3076>欢迎回家，希斯克利夫。</color>
